fix.new_file: src/lib/category-icons.ts — static named-import registry of the 15 icon names actually referenced by data + Folder fallback, exposing categoryIcon(name)

decomposition.method: diff the two per-file chunk lists in measure-3-baseline.json vs measure-3-after.json for /shop
decomposition.honest_caveat: the removal is NOT a single-cause clean decomposition: 2 of the 8 removed files are the barrel (726602 raw) while the other 6 and all 7 additions are the same modules re-hashed after the import graph changed. So the net saving is exactly measured, but 'registry cost = 27847 raw' is an APPROXIMATION of the non-barrel reshuffle, not the registry's own size. The independent verifier raised this and it is accepted.

registry_cost_added_back_approx.note: approximation of the non-barrel chunk reshuffle; see decomposition.honest_caveat
